Body.Content:
We are announcing the Multi-Grader Comparison feature in Power Platform. This feature will reach public preview on September 15, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature enables makers to compare the results of multiple graders applied to the same evaluation.

Key functionality of this feature includes:
  • Side-by-side grader comparison
  • Score comparison
  • Review of explanations from each grader
  • Analysis of grading consistency
What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.
